<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><rect width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#141922"/><text x="20" y="34" font-family="Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="1">HOOK TYPE</text><rect x="20" y="54" width="360" height="40" rx="20" fill="#e0412f"/><text x="200" y="81" font-family="Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1">BOLD CLAIM</text><text x="28" y="134" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-style="italic">Your intro is costing you half</text><text x="28" y="164" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-style="italic">your views.</text></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><rect width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#141922"/><text x="20" y="34" font-family="Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="1">HOOK TYPE</text><rect x="20" y="54" width="360" height="40" rx="20" fill="#e0412f"/><text x="200" y="81" font-family="Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1">IN THE ACTION</text><text x="28" y="134" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-style="italic">“…and that’s when the prompter</text><text x="28" y="164" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-style="italic">fell over.”</text></svg>
